headline: Executive order places the head of the Administration for Native Americans on Level V of the federal Executive Schedule pay scale.
what_it_does: The Executive Schedule is the pay scale for top officials in the federal government. This order adds the job of Commissioner of the Administration for Native Americans to Level V, the lowest level of that scale. This sets the pay rate for that position.

who_it_affects.group: The Commissioner of the Administration for Native Americans
who_it_affects.how: The person in this job is paid at the Level V rate of the Executive Schedule.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 12, 1994; the exact start date is not stated in the title.
